fieldValues.title: Every agent comment names its actor
fieldValues.decision_question: How is an agent comment told apart from the owner, when agents post with the owner token?
fieldValues.context: Proposed by agent:claude-code from the srs-lab control room (clerk#77). Prototyped against the live PRs on 2026-10-17: clerk#57 asked for thirteen decisions already ratified; srs-programme#154 and #155 proposed decisions only inside their diffs, in state draft; clerk#75 stated a constraining design principle in prose.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Every comment an agent posts carries its actor on its own line, as <!-- actor: agent:<id> -->.
fieldValues.rationale: Agents post through the owner token, so the author field cannot tell them apart; quorum comments already name their reviewer.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When agents post under their own GitHub identities.
